fixtures.title: Liquidity regime shift hypothesis
fixtures.summary: Form a deterministic hypothesis about liquidity regime changes in a fixed snapshot.
fixtures.hypothesis: If liquidity dispersion widens while breadth weakens, short-horizon trend continuation quality degrades.
experiment_plan: Measure breadth and dispersion over the supplied snapshot window.
Compare the observed regime to the previous fixed benchmark bucket.
Record evidence and next-step experiment criteria.
findings: The fixture signals a widening dispersion regime.
Breadth weakness aligns with lower confidence in continuation setups.

fixtures.title: Factor stability experiment
fixtures.summary: Run a deterministic factor stability experiment against a fixed data snapshot.
fixtures.hypothesis: A factor with stable cross-sectional rank persistence should keep its explanatory power across adjacent windows.
experiment_plan: Partition the snapshot into calibration and verification windows.
Compute rank persistence and evidence hashes.
Summarize the pass or fail criteria without issuing trade instructions.
findings: The fixture preserves stable rank persistence across adjacent windows.
Evidence quality is sufficient for a follow-up signal engine run.
